subject: design/feature-implementation-drive-local-git
statement: A review or approval state is never completion. Open, changes-requested, approved-but-unlanded, and landed-unverified proposals leave tasks and dependents incomplete. The current reviewed proposal head/base and required checks/reviews must be verified, and landed revision L must be an ancestor of the freshly fetched feature-branch head before idempotent RecordLanding(task, proposal, reviewed_head, L, feature_head). Tracker ambiguity, wrong base, stale head, missing proof/revision, or failed ancestry blocks new routing and preserves artifacts. Hosted human review/merge and merge/squash/rebase result resolution remain unchanged.
